form.notes: The stock-and-debt-basis limitation — the FIRST of the four loss limitations for an S corporation shareholder. Required whenever the shareholder reports a loss, receives a distribution, disposes of stock, or receives a loan repayment; Schedule E line 28 column (e) is the check box that asks.
